text: Refines D-0316, D-0321 and D-0327 for #582, step 2 of #564's plan: Sandbox.Run's repository checks use the real Go collector, D-0334's, for base, candidate and queued checks. A base check tries each selector independently, after build, suite and selected-package compilation failures, without carrying one case's outcome to another case, package, module or part. A candidate needs every command and every selector to pass. Real Go commands, discovery and execution share the original run and the one test phase that the suite or discovery starts, and they obey shorter caller, sandbox and preparer limits. Cancellation at any stage keeps partial work and bounded cleanup. A queued check keeps host authority and structured evidence, a waiting call is cancelled without running, and the slot is held until environment and staging cleanup finish, with cleanup errors vetoing a completed run. On 2026-11-04 the Docker orphan-reaping check passed on #589's head.
